messages:
DeployBot: Starting staged rollout r-1716678900 -> service=inference-api, version=v3.2.4, target=10% traffic, regions=[us-east-1, eu-west-1]. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Release notes https://go/release/v3.2.4 :rocket:
Anna: I'm release lead for this window, watching perf and quality. I'll call stop/go if anything notable. :eyes:
Priya: Observability checklist up: dashboards, embedding-regression eval, tail-latency heatmap, 5xx rate. Alerts wired to #incidents and my phone.
Ethan: Infra warmup done. KV cache prewarmed on both regions, autoscaler warm threshold reached. Ran `infra health check --service inference-api --warm` -> OK.
Lucy: PM note: tokenization tweak + embed model bump in this release. We have sample prompts in the eval harness. Please watch schema/embedding distribution.
DeployBot: Canary metrics (0m): error_rate=0.2%, p95=120ms (+4ms), embed-regression=0.3% on our sample set. Thresholds: error_rate>1.0% || p95>200ms || embed-regression>1.0% to auto-signal.
Priya: I'm seeing 0.8% of requests with slightly different embedding norms in eu-west sample (small sample size ~150). Not yet at trigger but worth flagging.
Anna: Ok — proposal: hold at 10% for 15m to collect more signal. Quick vote: GO to continue collection, STOP to rollback/pin. Reply with GO/STOP.
Ethan: GO from infra. No resource anomalies.
Lucy: GO — want more telemetry but ok to wait 15m.
Priya: STOP — embedding deviation looks directional on semantics for a subset of prompts (search recall may be impacted).
Anna: Thanks. I'm calling an initial PAUSE. Do not advance beyond current traffic. Priya, can you triage whether this is a dataset edgecase or model regression?
Priya: Triage started. Early note: mismatch concentrated on multi-sentence train prompts that include long instruction tokens. Investigating tokenization vs model behavior.
Ethan: Suggestion: isolate by region — keep us-east running (10%) and pin eu-west back to v3.2.3 to avoid customer impact there. I can update routing.
Anna: Good idea. Quick check: any objections to isolating eu-west and continuing observation in us-east? Voice now.
Lucy: agree with isolation.
DeployBot: Routing update queued: set traffic eu-west-1 -> pinned to v3.2.3; us-east-1 -> continue v3.2.4 at 10%. Applying now...
DeployBot: Routing update applied. r-1716678900: eu-west-1 pinned -> v3.2.3. us-east-1 remains 10% -> v3.2.4.
Ethan: Confirmed on the mesh: eu-west routes pinned, no more canary traffic there.
Priya: Continuing deeper eval on the eu-west sample with extended prompts. If we see embed-regression exceed 1.0% on a larger sample or degradations in recall, we'll recommend a full rollback.
Anna: For tracking: fallback runbook updated, rollback command saved: `deployctl rollback --id r-1716678900 --global` (only used after consensus).
Lucy: I'll update release notes with a note about partial region pin and follow-up ticket for tokenizer/embedding investigation. Ticket: INF-4821.
Anna: Final decision for this checkpoint: Proceed with observations in us-east (10%) only. No further traffic expansion until triage clears. If Priya calls STOP again, we'll rollback globally. Marking this thread as the stop/go checkpoint.
Priya: Acknowledged. I'll post a 15m follow-up with numbers or immediate STOP if thresholds hit.
Ethan: Thx all — infra on standby.
DeployBot: Checkpoint logged: r-1716678900 checkpoint=paused-regionally. Next auto-check in 15m.
